$comment: QF-MVP-30.1B Vendor CRM foundation CONTRACT MANIFEST. Schema/ACL contract only. NO production data or UUIDs. Access model = A (server-only via service_role). Canonical notes authority = vendor_internal_notes (evolved in place). All new tables expect ZERO rows on empty staging.
rejected_notes_alternative: a new public.vendor_notes table (would leave vendor_internal_notes as a competing writable notes authority)

uniqueness.vendor_tag_assignments: uq_vendor_tag_active partial unique (vendor_id, tag_id) WHERE removed_at IS NULL
uniqueness.vendor_contacts: uq_vendor_contacts_active_primary partial unique (vendor_id) WHERE is_primary AND is_active; uq_vendor_contacts_active_phone partial (vendor_id, lower(btrim(phone))) WHERE is_active AND phone IS NOT NULL
uniqueness.vendor_tasks: uq_vendor_tasks_idempotency partial unique (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL

fk_delete_behavior.crm_to_vendors: ON DELETE RESTRICT (evidence-preserving; vendors are soft-deleted by status)
fk_delete_behavior.actor_to_profiles: ON DELETE SET NULL (removing an admin never erases CRM history)
fk_delete_behavior.tag_assignment_to_tags: ON DELETE RESTRICT (archive tags via is_active; assignments via removed_at)
fk_delete_behavior.notes_supersedes_self: ON DELETE RESTRICT (append-only; rows never deleted)

rls: enabled on all six foundation tables

privileges.owner_postgres: inherent break-glass, documented, not an application path

immutability.vendor_internal_notes: append-only: UPDATE/DELETE blocked by trg_vin_immutable (BEFORE UPDATE|DELETE ROW); TRUNCATE blocked by trg_vin_no_truncate (BEFORE TRUNCATE STATEMENT); corrections are NEW notes via supersedes_note_id
immutability.updated_at_maintenance: trg_vcp_touch / trg_vco_touch / trg_vtg_touch / trg_vtk_touch via qf_crm_touch_updated_at()

authority_boundary: QuickFurno Core stays authoritative for vendor identity/verification/enabled/city/service-area/categories/package/credits/eligibility/consent/suppression/communication-authorization/campaign-eligibility. Vendor CRM owns only relationship extensions and holds NO authoritative copy. Jarvis/n8n never write CRM directly; the service-role key never reaches the browser/Jarvis/n8n.
